title: seekrit (local crypto plane)
description: Zero-knowledge secrets manager — local crypto-plane MCP server: decrypts and injects secrets.
summary: Zero-knowledge secrets manager — local crypto-plane MCP server: decrypts and injects secrets.
offersHint: Zero-knowledge secrets manager — local crypto-plane MCP server: decrypts and injects secrets. · Packages: npm:@seekrit/mcp · Env vars: SEEKRIT_API_URL, SEEKRIT_CLIENT_ID, SEEKRIT_CLIENT_SECRET, SEEKRIT_PASSPHRASE, SEEKRIT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: SEEKRIT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Machine (M2M) client id from POST https://mcp.seekrit.dev/signup — mints an admin token automatically, no separate token to copy.

environmentVariables.name: SEEKRIT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Machine (M2M) client secret paired with SEEKRIT_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: SEEKRIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An existing skt_… service or admin token, if you already have one instead of machine credentials.

environmentVariables.name: SEEKRIT_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for the token's private key. Required for tools that decrypt (get_secret, run_command) when authenticating with SEEKRIT_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: SEEKRIT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the hosted seekrit API.
